dict.Cât din vânzări merge pe comisioane: Share of sales paid as commission
dict.Comisionul se plătește de obicei odată c: The commission is usually paid with the salary (Sheets → Payroll), as salary income.
dict.Procent de la ținta atinsă: Rate once the target is met
dict.Schimbă procentele și bonusul din „Regul: Change the rates and the bonus under “Commission rules”: the whole table is recalculated.
dict.Un rând pe agent și lună: scrie vânzăril: One row per agent and month: enter the sales excluding VAT and the target; the commission and the bonus are worked out automatically.
dict.Vânzările fiecărui agent pe lună față de: Each agent’s monthly sales against the target: you get the achievement, the commission at the lower rate below target and the higher rate once the target is met, a bonus above a threshold and the total to pay; the rates and the bonus are changed in one place, on the right.
